product.name: Monoprice Low Profile 7.5 lb. Capacity Speaker Wall Mount Brackets (Pair) Black
product.description: Easily mount your satellite speakers on your wall with this Speaker Wall Mounting Bracket set from Monoprice™!These brackets are designed to mount small satellite speakers with a single‑bolt mounting system. Each bracket can support a speaker weighing up to about 7.5 lbs. (3.5 kg). Each bracket can be adjusted for tilt and swivel, so you can point each speaker to the proper angle for the optimum audio experience.The brackets can be mounted to wooden stud or brick/concrete/hollow‑block walls and includes the hardware necessary for either type of mounting option. Additionally, the kit includes M5x12 screws for mounting the speakers to the brackets. Each speaker mounts about 3" from the wall.Support Files: User's Manual (Sep 18, 2017)Dimensions Diagram (Sep 18, 2017)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
